shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50 && ls node_modules/next 2>/dev/null && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; cat node_modules/next/AGENTS.md | head -80
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -ril "cookies" . | head -30; echo; find . -iname "*cookies*" -o -iname "*headers*"

cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; (npx next dev -p 3456 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; curl -s localhost:3456 | grep -o '<main>.*</main>'; curl -s -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8' localhost:3456 | grep -o '<main>.*</main>'; pkill -f "next dev"
cat .gitignore; git diff tsconfig.json; head -20 AGENTS.md
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo AGENTS.md && git status --short
